coordinates: Module .text offsets, with OEM userspace export line anchors from privately held firmware

ivdc_workspace.owner: global FrameSource channel 0, when cached direct mode is nonzero

allocation_branch.reserved_address_set: use supplied physical address through kernel cached mapping

release_order: verify IVDC DDR Addr is zero in /proc/jz/isp/isp-ivdc
release_cautions: Do not clear supplied physical address before driver cleanup; it chooses the DMA-free ownership branch.
Closing a pre-STREAMON channel alone does not detach the workspace.
REQBUFS(0) does not propagate remote event-cleanup errors.
Printed buffer size remains stale after detach; the address is the useful indicator.

Derived failure-path requirement: after confirmed kernel detach, clear a never-consumed pending SET_PADDR before freeing its reserved allocation. The OEM successful shutdown does not issue this extra clear.

failure_profile_with_derived_workspace.memory_lines_basis: Retained boot configuration; this trial did not call GET_MEM_LINE.
failure_profile_with_derived_workspace.workspace_bytes_basis: Derived from the recovered sizing formula and boot-configured line count.

ae_sensor_slots.required_profile: Retained dual direct_mode=2 requires both CV2005 and CV2005S1 registered, even when publishing only sensor 0.
ae_sensor_slots.fault: AE selected slot 1, whose sensor attributes were NULL after registering only slot 0.
ae_sensor_slots.evidence: Fault address 0xb0; sensor record stride register was 0x5c (92), proving slot 1.

stream_lifecycle.oem_sensor_enable: Starts the global ISP and creates/enables links once.
stream_lifecycle.framesource: Streams its own frame-channel fd; must not repeat global sensor/link setup.
stream_lifecycle.fork_fix: Record stream/link flags after successful OEM80 EnableSensor.

qualification: Recovered interfaces and failure analysis; native fresh capture remains unqualified until independently decoded.
